# AI Resume Builder Project

## Project Overview
An AI-powered resume customization tool that helps users tailor their resumes based on job descriptions using Gen-AI.

## Features
- Chatbot interface for resume editing
- AI-powered job description analysis
- Resume customization based on job requirements
- Real-time preview of resume changes
- Template-based resume generation

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React + Vite
- Backend: Node.js + Express
- AI: OpenAI API
- Styling: TailwindCSS

## Next Steps
1. Install Node.js (v18+) if not already installed
2. Navigate to `backend/` and run `npm install`
3. Navigate to `frontend/` and run `npm install`
4. Copy `backend/.env.example` to `backend/.env`
5. Add your OpenAI API key to the `.env` file
6. Run backend: `cd backend && npm run dev`
7. Run frontend: `cd frontend && npm run dev`
8. Open http://localhost:3000 in your browser
